display.purpose: Hero headline only — large, black-weight, cramped leading.

title.purpose: Product names, cart/modal headings — regular weight, supports rather than competes with Display.

label.purpose: Nav links, eyebrows, button text, marquee, badges — always uppercase and wide-tracked.

shadows.name: overlay-ambient
shadows.purpose: The system's only shadow. Reserved exclusively for floating overlay panels (cart drawer, size-guide sheet); never used on cards, buttons, or product imagery.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default transition easing (color/opacity/border shifts, panel slide).

motion.name: ease-image
motion.purpose: Product image hover scale (700ms) and crossfade (500ms) — deliberately slower and softer than UI transitions.

motion.name: duration-panel
motion.purpose: Cart drawer / backdrop slide and fade.

motion.name: duration-marquee
motion.purpose: Full loop of the marquee scroll; linear, infinite, disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The system's default call-to-action — full Ledger Ink fill, hovers straight to Thread Sepia.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #1A1A1A; color: #F4EEE4; padding: 14px 32px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.18em; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #A6552F; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #A6552F; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action — transparent with an Ledger Ink border, becomes the primary button on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: transparent; color: #1A1A1A; border: 1px solid #1A1A1A; padding: 14px 32px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.18em; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #1A1A1A; color: #F4EEE4; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #A6552F; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-product-card { display: block; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; } .ds-product-card-media { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 3 / 4; overflow: hidden; background: #E8DFCF; } .ds-product-card-media img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; transition: transform 0.7s ease-out; } .ds-product-card:hover .ds-product-card-media img { transform: scale(1.04); } .ds-product-card-badge { position: absolute; top: 12px; left: 12px; background: rgba(244, 238, 228, 0.85); color: #1A1A1A; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.2em; padding: 4px 8px; } .ds-product-card-meta { margin-top: 12px; display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-product-card-name { font-family: Fraunces, Georgia, serif; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.2; margin: 0; font-weight: 400; } .ds-product-card-price { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #3A3A3A; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Zero-radius bordered field; the only focus treatment is a border-color shift plus the standard focus-visible outline.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.25); background: #F4EEE4; color: #1A1A1A; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; border-radius: 0; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(58, 58, 58, 0.6); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #A6552F; outline: 2px solid #A6552F; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Count Badge
components.description: Circular cart/wishlist item-count indicator — the system's only default use of full radius.
components.css: .ds-badge-count { display: inline-flex; min-width: 20px; height: 20px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 9999px; background: #1A1A1A; color: #F4EEE4; padding: 0 5px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Order/fulfillment status indicator — color reinforces the text label, never replaces it.
components.css: .ds-status-pill { display: inline-block; border-radius: 2px; padding: 4px 8px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-status-pill--paid { background: #E8DFCF; color: #1A1A1A; } .ds-status-pill--pending { background: rgba(166, 85, 47, 0.15); color: #8A4524; }

components.css: .ds-nav { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.1); background: rgba(244, 238, 228, 0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); } .ds-nav-inner { max-width: 1280px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 20px; height: 64px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 24px; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-nav-link { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.18em; color: #3A3A3A; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { color: #1A1A1A; } .ds-nav-wordmark { font-family: Fraunces, Georgia, serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 900; color: #1A1A1A; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; } .ds-nav-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.18em; color: #1A1A1A; text-decoration: none; }

components.name: Marquee
components.description: Signature component — an infinitely scrolling Ledger Ink band of tracked phrases separated by a Thread Sepia divider glyph. The one place the accent color appears purely as a mark, not a state.
components.html: FREE SHIPPING OVER $200 ✦THE ARCHIVE DROP IS LIVE ✦
components.css: .ds-marquee { overflow: hidden; border-top: 1px solid rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.15); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.15); background: #1A1A1A; padding: 10px 0; color: #F4EEE4; } .ds-marquee-track { display: flex; width: max-content; white-space: nowrap; animation: ds-marquee 24s linear infinite; } .ds-marquee-item { margin: 0 32px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.3em; opacity: 0.9; } .ds-marquee-dot { margin: 0 16px; color: #A6552F; } @keyframes ds-marquee { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-50%); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-marquee-track { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Nostalgia is a tailor's ledger, not a costume box. Every surface behaves like it was cut, not decorated: sharp corners, flat planes, restrained ornament, and a single accent color spent as rarely and precisely as a maker signs their work. The "nostalgic" half of the brand lives in the editorial serif display and the film-grain atmosphere over the page — the memory of an era. The "luxury" half lives in what the system refuses to do: no gradients, no soft shadows, no rounded-card softness, no ornament that isn't load-bearing. Craft and materials are the claim; nostalgia is the mood the craft is presented in, never the other way around.

The system is confident and tactile rather than shy — buttons commit to full-block color and an assertive hover shift to the accent, type runs large and black-weight at the display size, and the marquee band never apologizes for taking up space. But that confidence is expressed through precision (alignment, tracking, exact padding), not through decoration. Anti-reference: this system explicitly does not look like loud streetwear graphics, hype-logo drop culture, or graphic-tee visual noise — the claim is craft and materials, not costume.
keyCharacteristics: Zero-radius, flat-by-default surfaces; shadow is a rare, ambient exception, never a default treatment.
One accent color (Thread Sepia), spent almost exclusively on hover states and rare emphasis — never as a resting decoration.
Display type is large, black-weight, and serif; everything navigational or categorical is small, uppercase, and wide-tracked.
Atmosphere comes from a fixed film-grain overlay and photographic hover crossfades, not from gradients or drop shadows.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Thread Sepia is the only color in the system that means "interactive" or "emphasis." It never appears as a resting background, a decorative block, or a second accent alongside itself — its rarity is what makes it register.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Any label that categorizes or contextualizes content (section eyebrows, category badges, the marquee) is uppercase, wide-tracked (≥0.18em), and small — never the accent color at rest, only Pencil Ink or the AA-safe Waxed Thread.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Nothing gets a shadow simply for being a "card" or a button. Depth is earned only by panels that visually float above the entire page.

rules.name: The Sharp-Cut Rule
rules.body: Any surface that is structural — a button, a product image, a card, an input, a page section border — carries zero radius. If something needs a curve, it must be a badge, a pill, or one of the two named overlay panels; there is no in-between "slightly rounded" surface anywhere in the system.

dos: Do keep every structural surface — buttons, product imagery, cards, inputs, section borders — at zero radius (The Sharp-Cut Rule).
Do spend Thread Sepia only on hover states, focus outlines, ratings, and the marquee divider — never as a resting decorative fill (The One Accent Rule).
Do set anything navigational or categorical (nav links, eyebrows, button labels, the marquee) in uppercase, wide-tracked label type (The Eyebrow Rule).
Do let the film-grain overlay and the product-image hover crossfade carry texture and motion interest instead of gradients or shadows.
Do pair the Thread Sepia :focus-visible outline with an input's border-color shift as the only focus treatments — never a box-shadow ring or glow.
donts: Don't add a drop shadow to a button, card, or product image — shadow-xl is reserved for the cart drawer and size-guide sheet only, and even there it's ambient, not structural (The Flat-by-Default Rule).
Don't round the corners of a structural surface — radius is reserved for circular badges/pills and the size-guide bottom sheet, nothing in between.
Don't reach for loud streetwear graphics, hype-logo treatments, or drop-culture visual noise — confirmed anti-reference; the brand claim is craft and materials.
Don't invent specific fabric, construction, or material claims in copy near these components — PRODUCT.md records those as undecided, owner-supplied facts.
Don't drift the locked palette, type pairing, grain, or marquee device — they are durable brand identity, not a page-level styling choice.
